title: Chapter 6 Bricklayers And Brick Houses
content:
Chapter 6 Bricklayers And Brick Houses

Next, he still had a lot to do.

First, he put the pottery pot on the fire pit and added 1 liter of water to it. After the water boiled, it could be drunk.

Then he pinched some bowls, cups, water tanks and other items with his hands and placed them beside the fire pit.

After a few minutes, he would definitely get the "synthesis formula" of these items.

Then he tried to use the "synthesis formula" to make 10 bricks, which took 10 minutes. During this period, the "synthesis formula" of bowls and cups had also come out.

He just tried it and found that he could use bricks and tiles to replace part of the wood and upgrade the shack to a brick and tile house.

This discovery made him very excited.

He did the same thing again and got the "synthesis formula" of tiles.

[10 tiles = 1 clay + 1 wood]

The production of tiles is similar to that of bricks, and 10 tiles can be obtained in 1 minute.

He looked at the [backpack] and found that there were still 23 pieces of wood, and he had plenty of clay, which was enough to make bricks and tiles.

He silently chanted to make "mud bricks" and "tiles" in his mind.

But he found that he could only make one at a time.

System manufacturing does not require hands-on work, but it takes time. It takes 1.5 hours to make 90 bricks, and 10 minutes to make 100 tiles, and it is almost 5 o'clock now.

He had a hunch that if he did not upgrade the shack before 6 o'clock, he might encounter irresistible danger.

It is estimated that it will take half an hour to upgrade the shack, and now there is only half an hour to make these 90 bricks and 90 tiles.

"What should I do?" Wang Shuo frowned, anxious like an ant on a hot pot.

At this point, he can only try his best.

Use the original method to make bricks.

He immediately ignited the wood in his backpack and made 10 fire piles. He placed 4 pieces of clay around each fire pile and stacked them in 2 layers, so that 8 pieces can be made at the same time.

The remaining mud bricks and tiles were synthesized by the system.

Next, it was time to wait...

After waiting for a while, he simply pinched some more pots, bowls, ladles, basins, spoons and other cooking utensils and placed them beside the fire pit.

[Water Tank +1]

[Since you have done your own research and successfully obtained a water tank, you are hereby rewarded with the "Water Tank Synthesis Formula". ]

...

[Earth Bricks +8]

[Tiles +10]

...

The system prompts kept ringing and never stopped, making him upset, so he simply turned off the sound prompts.

Focus on pottery and use technology to lead the future...

20 minutes later, Wang Shuo finally had 101 earth bricks and 100 tiles in his backpack.

He took a look at the upgrade conditions and found that he was still short of 10 stones and 10 wood.

He was busy all day today, collecting whatever resources he had, and he didn't deliberately collect stones. At this moment, there was not even a single stone in his backpack, only a few pieces of gravel, and the wood had been used up.

It was almost too late, so he immediately opened the [Chat Channel].

Zhao Tianze: "5 soil for 5 food."

Zhou Guang: "To upgrade the wooden house, there are still 20 woods missing. I can exchange them with 2 rabbit meats."

ID:5678Wang Shuo: "Fat crucian carp, 5 fish for 10 stone and 10 wood, hurry up!"

...

At this time, the chat channel was full of information about various resource exchanges. For a moment, the atmosphere was very tense, and Wang Shuo also felt a hint of unusual taste.

Wang Shiyuan: "Who can save me? In the fog, it seems that there is a pair of eyes staring at me."

Zhang Xiaojun: "Bear..., I saw a bear near my shack, ah..."

Then, his name turned gray, and all the text disappeared strangely.

"He won't die, will he?" Wang Shuo panicked, his heartbeat accelerated, and he broke out in a cold sweat.

He quickly checked the [Task Bar].

The number of people alive in the current area will decrease by 1 every few seconds, and now it has dropped to 9860/10000.

While Wang Shuo was still in shock, a transaction message popped up.

Ding San: "Brother, I'm starving. Give me the fish. I have stone and wood."

"Okay."

Time was tight, Wang Shuo didn't waste words, and the transaction was completed quickly.

[Stone +10, Wood +10, Fish -5]

The materials were collected, and the time was now 5:28 pm. Wang Shuo immediately silently recited "upgrade brick house".

[Brick house: earth brick 101/100, tile 100/100, wood 10/10, stone 10/10]

[Are you sure you want to upgrade the shack to a brick house? ]

"OK."

[Earth brick -100, tile -100, wood -10, stone -10]

[Brick house is under construction, it will take 1 hour. ]

...

"What? 1 hour?"

Wang Shuo's heart seemed to be full of horses!

He hurried to the [chat channel] and asked the players who had successfully upgraded the wooden house. The result was that it took half an hour to upgrade the wooden house.

"Is it my fault? I made the upgrade materials too advanced? I took a big step and made a mess?"

"It seems that man proposes, God disposes. I will eventually fall before dawn."

It's like playing a game. When the enemy keeps hitting you with combos and you are doomed to die, you can leave the keyboard with your hands.

Wang Shuo sat down dejectedly, as if he had drained all his strength, and murmured in a low voice: "Is all my efforts in vain?"

It took Wang Shuo only a few seconds to go from feeling hopeless to rekindling his desire for life.

Even when faced with a situation where he was doomed to die, he never wanted to sit and wait for death. From childhood to adulthood, he always believed that there was always a way out.

"God has a good heart and will leave a glimmer of hope for the world."

Wang Shuo couldn't remember who said this.

He looked at the upgrade time and it would take another 50 minutes. There were still 10 minutes until 6pm.

He kept checking the various functions in the "Survivor's Manual" in the hope of finding a glimmer of hope.

Time passed bit by bit, but everything was in vain, and Wang Shuo became more and more anxious.

At this moment, the system prompt sounded:

[Spoon +1]

[Ceramic Basin +]

...

In a series of system prompts, his backpack was full.

He quickly took the pots and pans out of his backpack, and then the system prompt sounded again:

[Clay pot +1]

[The player has been detected to have made more than 20 pottery and 10 pottery types through self-exploration, and will be awarded the talent of "Pottery Mastery". ]

[Pottery Mastery: The player's pottery making time is shortened by half, and the chance of obtaining high-quality pottery is increased. ]

[The player has been detected to have the skill "Mixed mud" and the talent "Pottery Mastery", and will be awarded the "Bricklayer" secondary occupation transfer certificate. ]

["Bricklayer" secondary occupation transfer certificate: allows players to learn a life profession - "Bricklayer" transfer certificate. Players have a chance to unlock more related professional skills without using skill scrolls. ]

The talent and transfer certificate reward made Wang Shuo a little confused for a while. Regardless of anything, he immediately clicked on the transfer certificate to transfer.

[Do you want to transfer to Bricklayer? ]

Although this profession seems a bit low, it is better than nothing, and Wang Shuo is not in a position to be picky at this time.

"Yes."

[Congratulations to the player for successfully obtaining the mason profession. Since you are the first player to have a life profession, you will be rewarded with "Primary Construction Acceleration Scroll" × 3, "Advanced Fishing Net Production Drawing" × 1, and Huilingzhu × 1. ]

[Mason: The speed of making pottery is doubled, and more related professional skills can be unlocked by yourself. ]

[You have obtained new skills, please check them yourself. ]

[System announcement: Player ID: 5678 Wang Shuo, the first to learn the life profession, hereby announce. ]

A series of changes caught Wang Shuo off guard, but the "Primary Construction Acceleration Scroll" was like a life-saving straw, giving him hope.

Without time to think about it, he immediately used an acceleration scroll.

[Do you want to use a "Primary Construction Acceleration Scroll" on the "Brick and Tile House" to shorten the construction time by 30 minutes? ]

"Yes."

It was only half an hour to find an acceleration scroll, so Wang Shuo quickly used another one.

[The brick house has been successfully upgraded. ]

[Brick house: Durability 200/200, has a stronger energy recovery effect than the wooden house, is stronger and warmer. ]

Wang Shuo's shelter was suddenly transformed from a shabby shack, skipping the wooden house upgrade process, to a brick house that can not only shelter from the wind and rain, but also has stronger warmth retention.

Although it is just a brick house, this is not the point. The point is that he finally has a house now.
